title: Grace Sea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Nestled in the trees, Grace Sea is a perfect hideaway to escape from it all. Located near Westside Pool, this is the guest house to Seabiscuit cottage.
description_expanded: Description750 FOREST STREET1 KING BED, 1 DOUBLE SLEEPER SOFAWelcome to Grace SeaTucked away beneath the shade of mature trees, Grace Sea is a charming guest cottage offering a peaceful escape just steps from the heart of Seaside, Florida. Located behind the main home Sandy Toes, this private retreat is only a 3-minute walk to the beach and just 400 feet from the West Side Pool, making it an ideal getaway for couples or small families seeking both comfort and convenience.Outdoor Living & Coastal CharmGuests are welcomed by a cozy open-air front porch featuring club seating for two and a bistro table—perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The cottage also offers a private rear grilling area with Adirondack seating and a charcoal grill, creating the ideal space for casual outdoor meals under the trees. A second screened porch off the bedroom adds another peaceful spot to unwind.Comfortable Living & Thoughtful DesignInside, the open-concept living space feels bright and welcoming. The living room features a built-in stereo system, LCD TV, DVD/VCR, and a double sleeper sofa (best suited for children). The adjacent kitchen is fully equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a double-door refrigerator, dishwasher, four-burner electric stove/oven, and a full-size microwave. A breakfast bar seats two, with an additional dining table for two nearby—perfect for easy meals at home.Private Bedroom RetreatThe king bedroom offers a peaceful escape with a mounted flat-screen TV, generous storage, and direct access to a private screened porch furnished with cushioned seating and a ceiling fan. The ensuite bathroom has been recently updated with quartz countertops, a single vanity, and a tub/shower combination, blending comfort with modern style.Added Comforts & ConvenienceGrace Sea includes a stackable washer and dryer for guest use, making longer stays even more comfortable. For additional room, the main three-bedroom cottage, Seabiscuit, may also be rented, or the full 4-bedroom home, Sandy Toes.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Pensacola Pavilion176 yards / 3-minute walk to the beachSeaside is the largest private residential beach on 30ATwo private porches for outdoor relaxationPrivate rear charcoal grillAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass per one-bedroom cottage (golf carts are considered vehicles; non-homeowner golf carts are prohibited—medical exceptions require a permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002045
